name: crowdkart
description: CrowdKart - Order individually. Discover collectively. Deliver intelligently.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w client && npm run cap:sync -w client
